entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: A cult of machine worshipers in Soldev during the Ice Age who aspired to be compleated.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Possessed pyromancer who helped wake the Phyrexian War Beasts.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beasts
entities.description: Beasts excavated at Koilos by Arcum Dagsson and woken by the Adnates.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Artificer who excavated the War Beasts and designed the Steam Beasts.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Machines designed from the War Beasts' blueprints that were taken over.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: Land destroyed after the War Beasts awoke.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Site where Dagsson excavated the War Beasts.

events.summary: With a possessed Jaya Ballard, the Adnates wake the Phyrexian War Beasts, which take control of the Steam Beasts and destroy Soldev.
events.quote: they woke the Phyrexian War Beasts that Arcum Dagsson had excavated at Koilos
